class.name: BBNode
class.description:
Node-type parameter intended for use with [BehaviorTree] tasks. See [BBParam]. If the source is a blackboard variable, it allows any type extended from [Object].
Creating a new [BBNode] and setting it from source uses the path of the target node in the tree, for example: [codeblock] # Example: set a BTPlayAnimation task to point at a specific AnimationPlayer var bbnode: BBNode = BBNode.new()
# Set it directly via the node in question bbnode.saved_value = $AnimationPlayer # Or use a NodePath() bbnode.saved_value = NodePath($AnimationPlayer.get_path())
bt_play_animation.animation_player = bbnode [/codeblock]
